title_lines: Listen: does the ground rise or fall?
question: Is the origin a peak, a pit, or a saddle?
hint_lines: A saddle goes UP one way and DOWN the other. 💡

options.label: A
options.explain: Not a peak — one direction goes downhill. 🙂

options.label: B
options.explain: Not a pit — one direction goes uphill. 🙂

options.label: D
options.explain: Not flat — the ground really curves. 🙂

success_text: YES! A saddle — up one way, down the other. 🎉
